mike: FYI p99 host-side parse latency jumped ~2.4x after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak. noticed while triaging a customer tail spike.

julia: saw the alert. can repro on staging with mixed short+long seq traffic. short requests unaffected. long seqs (1k+) show big stalls.

sarah: KV cache metrics overlapped — eviction rate doubled around the same commit. could be binning change causing different kv-touch patterns.

mike: quick profiling dump (host-side):
``
flame: host_preparse -> tokenize -> serialize -> grpc_writev
p50  4.2ms -> 1.1ms -> 0.7ms -> 0.8ms
p95  9.8ms -> 3.6ms -> 2.5ms -> 7.2ms
p99 18.3ms -> 9.9ms -> 6.5ms -> 24.0ms
```
Notable: grpc_writev p99 up 3x, serialize stage up 2.5x.

alex: i dumped the kernel selector logs. after change we prefer 'chunked_large' for inputs >128 tokens instead of 'mini_chunk' because of batching heuristics. That changes how we prepare token buffers and forces extra memcpy for big KV frames.

julia: confirmed — kernel bin transitions introduce a jittered path: code path flips and triggers a different serialization layout. extra memcpy + non-contiguous IO -> gRPC writev fragmentation.

sarah: KV cache impact: larger chunks mean different key prefixes get hit together -> hotter shards -> eviction churn. increased misses cause awkward fallback to re-fetch which also uses host-side parse path.

mike: i ran a quick A/B on staging: revert kernel bin change -> p99 parse latency returns to baseline. patching kernel selection to include a hysteresis window (avoid flip for small delta in seq length) reduces flips.

julia: proposed change snippet for selector (pseudo):
``
if abs(bin_size_prev - bin_size_new) < 32 && recent_flip_count < 3:
  keep_prev_bin()
else:
  switch_bin()
```
This keeps stable bins during mini-bursts.

alex: also worth trying grouped writev coalescing at host side before handing to gRPC to reduce syscall bursts. cheap win: coalesce up to 16 fragments or 64KB.

sarah: and add a KV-cache backpressure metric so selector can avoid switching to chunk size that exacerbates eviction when shard load > 75%.

mike: created an initial repro script and perf run (staging): /run/repro/1768500123.sh — results attached in thread. Plan: 1) add selector hysteresis + perf test, 2) host-side writev coalesce, 3) kv backpressure guard, 4) canary the change.

julia: i'll own the selector patch, will open PR with benchmarks. tagging @alex for writev coalesce follow-up.

alex: ack. i'll prototype coalesce and run microbench vs current gRPC path.
